methodology: This story is generated from Wikipedia best-selling video game tables for Nintendo Switch: List of best-selling Nintendo Switch video games. The adapter finds tables with game/title and copies-sold columns, converts displayed million-copy values into copy totals, ranks the configured Top 20, and stores StoryOps snapshots so observed history can accumulate over time. When the same game appears on multiple configured platform pages, the adapter keeps the largest platform-specific value.
